answer.answer: Counts from a 0.333 mm net and a 0.300 mm net are not directly comparable because smaller mesh captures more small particles, inflating counts; a size-distribution-dependent correction factor (commonly cited up to roughly 2-3x) is needed to convert 0.333 mm counts to an equivalent 0.300 mm-window estimate. No single universal factor exists since it depends on the particle size distribution of each study.
